items.title: Make one evidence-ranked collapse contract the sole source for observed death facts, explicitly inferred contributing factors, remediation copy, and telemetry.
items.why: damageSequence already preserves an observed, bounded, non-causal final-damage window, but runDebrief, runIntelligence, deathFlow, and DeathScreen independently elevate wave/streak/grenade heuristics into CAUSE OF COLLAPSE and Diagnosis. The remediation action can therefore diverge from the strongest evidence and the UI overstates correlation.
items.recipe: Create a pure versioned collapse-coaching model with observed / likely-factor / hypothesis ranks, stable reason codes, sanitized evidence, and a single primary statement. Feed it the damage receipt plus existing run summaries; make buildRunDebrief, post-run intelligence, RUN THE FIX, DeathScreen labels, and Studio telemetry consume the same contract. Render OBSERVED FINISH when direct receipts exist and LIKELY FACTOR or COACHING HYPOTHESIS otherwise. Add fixtures for burst, attrition, absent receipt, unused cooldown, low-wave, and conflicting signals; forbid the words cause/diagnosis unless the contract explicitly carries observed causal authority, which this client does not.

L1.recipe: Relabel causal UI copy and add evidence-level metadata to existing outputs.

L2.recipe: Create a pure ranked model and route DeathScreen plus RUN THE FIX through it with focused tests.

L3.recipe: Unify debrief, remediation, UI, and telemetry on a versioned evidence contract with conflict and sanitization tests.

items.title: Remove the propagated hosted timer and make schedule/runner/Git-writer policy source-derived and regression-gated.
items.emergedFrom: Studio Ark compliance-task 01JUIVM51E88FB7E076DE93B79 after the initial closeout
items.why: The live brief-format workflow still carried a daily GitHub-hosted cron even though the current fleet policy forbids hosted timers. The task's generic self-hosted-runner wording conflicts with live Studio Canon, which forbids GitHub Actions self-hosted runners. A one-line timer deletion without a guard would silently regress on the next propagation pass.
items.recipe: Remove the schedule trigger while retaining push, pull-request, and explicit manual dispatch on GitHub-hosted runners. Add schedule-policy-receipt-v1 to hash every workflow and fail on any schedule trigger, self-hosted runner, or scheduled Git writer. Run it inside the brief workflow, test block/inline/self-hosted/writer fixtures, and route the canonical template conflict to Studio Ops through signed Ark cargo.

L2.recipe: Add a deterministic repository-wide workflow policy receipt and focused fixtures.

L3.recipe: Self-enforce the guard in CI, bind exact workflow digests, preserve the canon-safe runner posture, and route the propagation root fix upstream.
